physicalNotes: No radius or mass of the Hercules Cluster is recorded: it is an extended cluster of galaxies, and its package frames it at 5000000 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value: chosen to hold the Cosmicflows-4 group the field draws here, whose galaxies (Abell 2147, 2151 and 2152 as one group) lie within about 5 Mpc of this position; 1.5 times its R500 radius would be 1.19 Mpc and frames almost none of them.

sources.properMotion: Zero: the cluster of galaxies is held at its published position; no motion across the sky is applied.
